summary_ja: Genesis MissionのORNL主導9件から、fusion設計、neuromorphic AI、foundation-model factory、critical minerals、自律科学network運用、水・土壌・地球system、fusion材料という将来workload classを追加しました。定量的資源要件と成果は未確認です。単一モデルによる暫定調査でConsensusは未完了です。
summary_en: From nine ORNL-led Genesis Mission projects, this update adds future workload classes spanning fusion design, neuromorphic AI, a foundation-model factory, critical minerals, autonomous-science network operations, water, soil and Earth systems, and fusion materials. Quantitative resource requirements and outcomes remain unverified. This is provisional single-model research with Consensus incomplete.

sections.summary_en: Represent future demand as workload classes spanning simulation, experiments, geospatial data, control, agents, and neuromorphic computing rather than as one model size.

items.name_ja: ORNL主導9 projectが示す異種AI for Science需要
items.name_en: Heterogeneous AI-for-Science demand across nine ORNL-led projects
items.statement_ja: ORNLが主導するGenesis Mission 9件は、HPCとrobot設計を統合するfusion plant、neuromorphic低電力AI、産業向けfoundation-model factory Pipit、rare-earth探索、組織間のagentic/scientific workflow network運用、continental-scale水予測、soil biogeochemistry、数週から数年のEarth-system予測、fusion材料のprocess-microstructure-performance連携を対象とします。これは学習・推論以外にsimulation coupling、streaming、graph/geospatial data、control、heterogeneous accelerator、cross-institution networkが需要軸になることを示します。一方、各projectのmodel規模、data量、latency、accuracy、compute予算、実測speedupは未公表です。
items.statement_en: The nine ORNL-led Genesis Mission projects cover fusion-plant design integrating HPC and robotics, low-energy neuromorphic AI, the Pipit foundation-model factory for industry, rare-earth exploration, network operations for agentic and scientific workflows across institutions, continental-scale water forecasting, soil biogeochemistry, Earth-system prediction from weeks to years, and process-microstructure-performance links for fusion materials. They indicate demand dimensions beyond training and inference, including simulation coupling, streaming, graph and geospatial data, control, heterogeneous accelerators, and cross-institution networking. Model sizes, data volumes, latency and accuracy targets, compute budgets, and measured speedups are not yet public for each project.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: HPCI整備案の代表workloadは、dense AI trainingだけでなく、各classのdata movement、latency、precision、control、security、science-quality条件を少なくとも1件ずつ含めるべきです。
items.hpci_relevance_en: Representative workloads for HPCI planning should include at least one case from each class with its data movement, latency, precision, control, security, and scientific-quality requirements rather than only dense AI training.
adoption_conditions_ja: 各classについてmodel/data規模、training/inference比、simulation coupling、deadline、quality metricを定義する。
CPU、GPU、neuromorphic、storage、network、実験装置の資源時間をend-to-endで測る。
採択課題数ではなく再現可能workflowと科学成果で代表性を検証する。
adoption_conditions_en: Define model and data scale, training-to-inference mix, simulation coupling, deadlines, and quality metrics for each class.
Measure CPU, GPU, neuromorphic, storage, network, and instrument time end to end.
Validate representativeness through reproducible workflows and scientific outcomes rather than award counts.

items.name_en: Network operations for cross-institution agentic and scientific workflows
items.timing_ja: 2026年採択、実証時期とservice levelは未公表
items.timing_en: Selected in 2026; demonstration timing and service levels undisclosed
items.statement_ja: 9件の一つは、組織境界を跨ぐagentic workflowとscientific workflowのnetwork trafficを調整するAI-powered operationsを対象とします。American Science CloudはDOE 17研究所のcompute、実験施設、data、高性能networkを結ぶ構想です。公開情報は目的を示す段階であり、agent protocol、identity delegation、data policy、traffic class、reservation、failure recovery、監査、性能目標は確認できません。
items.statement_en: One of the nine projects targets AI-powered operations that coordinate network traffic for agentic and scientific workflows across institutional boundaries. The American Science Cloud is intended to link compute, experimental facilities, data, and high-performance networks across DOE's 17 laboratories. Public information currently establishes the objective, not agent protocols, identity delegation, data policy, traffic classes, reservations, failure recovery, audit mechanisms, or performance targets.
items.hpci_relevance_ja: HPCIの科学AI agentは、単一center内のchat serviceではなく、委任identity、最小権限、data locality、network予約、tool実行監査を含む連合workloadとして設計する必要があります。
items.hpci_relevance_en: Scientific AI agents in HPCI should be designed as federated workloads with delegated identity, least privilege, data locality, network reservations, and tool-execution auditing rather than as chat services within one center.
adoption_conditions_ja: human、agent、service accountの委任範囲と失効を標準化する。
data分類に応じた移動可否、処理場所、model接続先、log保管をpolicy化する。
deadline、帯域、失敗時fallback、costをworkflow traceで評価する。
adoption_conditions_en: Standardize delegation scope and revocation for humans, agents, and service accounts.
Define movement, processing location, model endpoint, and log retention by data classification.
Evaluate deadlines, bandwidth, failure fallback, and cost in workflow traces.
